rows.ARS:
Deep pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Otto de Jager
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2012).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2012 as 'Otto de Jager'.
rows.Bloom: Cerise, red shading. Outer petals reflex as they unfold with the inside showing the typical full incurved petals. Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for cut flower.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Named after the kIng of events management, Otto de Jager, in honour for popularising the use of big open rose blooms for wedding bouquets and table decorations.
